proposal.reactor_type: Packed-bed catalytic hydrogenation column (CatCart-style cartridge, 10% Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 pellets, H-Cube-type configuration)
proposal.tubing_material: 316 stainless steel (catalyst cartridge body); PFA/PTFE (transfer lines)
proposal.residence_time_basis: Total in-reactor volumetric flow (liquid + pressure-corrected H2 gas) at 60 °C / 15 bar operating conditions
proposal.light_setup: Not applicable (thermal/catalytic hydrogenation, no photochemical activation)

streams.pump_role: Gas feed (MFC or in-line H2 generator, e.g., electrolytic H-Cube module)

proposal.mixer_type: T-mixer with static mixing insert (gas-liquid CIJ) directly upstream of the packed catalyst bed
proposal.mixing_order_reasoning: H2 gas is introduced and finely dispersed into the MeOH/AcOH substrate stream immediately before the catalyst bed to maximize gas-liquid-solid contact area; premature separation of phases would reduce hydrogenolysis efficiency and risk catalyst channeling.
pre_reactor_steps: Degas MeOH solvent under N2/vacuum to remove dissolved O2
Filter substrate solution (0.2 µm) to prevent catalyst bed clogging
Preheat liquid line to 60 °C via heat exchanger before mixer
Saturate H2 into liquid stream in a short pre-mixing coil (0.5 mL, 60 °C) before entering catalyst cartridge
post_reactor_steps: Back-pressure regulator (15 bar) to maintain H2 dissolution and single-phase flow through the bed
In-line gas-liquid separator to vent excess H2 safely through a catalytic recombiner/flame arrestor
Collect liquid effluent; strip MeOH/AcOH by rotary evaporation or in-line falling-film evaporator
Optional: quench residual AcOH with mild aqueous base wash before isolation of 3-azetidinol
proposal.chemistry_notes: This is a Pd(OH)2/Al2O3-catalyzed hydrogenolytic debenzylation, cleaving the N-CHPh2 bond to release diphenylmethane and regenerate the free azetidine NH, with concomitant consumption of 1 equiv H2. AcOH is used to protonate the azetidine nitrogen, improving substrate solubility/adsorption on the Pd surface and accelerating hydrogenolysis kinetics. Flow processing with a packed catalyst bed increases catalyst surface-to-volume ratio and gas-liquid mass transfer relative to batch slurry hydrogenation, allowing much shorter residence times (minutes vs. hours) for equivalent or improved conversion. Care must be taken to avoid over-reduction or azetidine ring-opening at extended residence times or excessive H2 partial pressure.

stage_1_gas_liquid_mixing.purpose: Pre-saturate H2 into MeOH/AcOH substrate stream

stage_2_catalytic_hydrogenolysis.purpose: Hydrogenolytic cleavage of N-CHPh2 bond over Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 packed bed

stage_3_depressurization_separation.purpose: Release excess H2, isolate liquid product stream

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Estimated from total in-reactor volumetric flow (liquid + gas, pressure-corrected) through a 10 mL packed bed; flow intensification via increased catalyst surface area justifies major reduction from 5 h batch time.
reasoning_per_field.flow_rate_mL_min: Sum of liquid (0.4 mL/min) and in-channel H2 gas (1.22 mL/min) flows at reactor T/P.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Matches batch condition (60 °C), sufficient for Pd(OH)2-catalyzed hydrogenolysis without significant azetidine ring strain issues.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: 0.3 M chosen as a practical, non-viscous concentration for stable pumping and full catalyst wetting; original batch concentration not specified, so this is an assumed practical value.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: 15 bar provides sufficient H2 solubility in MeOH for efficient hydrogenolysis while remaining within standard flow-hydrogenation equipment limits (H-Cube/Vapourtec-type, rated to 100 bar).
reasoning_per_field.reactor_type: Packed-bed catalyst cartridge chosen to directly translate Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 heterogeneous catalyst from batch autoclave to continuous flow, analogous to commercial H-Cube CatCart systems.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: 316 SS withstands H2 at pressure/temperature without permeation; PFA/PTFE used for corrosion-resistant, low-swell transfer lines compatible with MeOH/AcOH.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: 10 mL cartridge size chosen to allow multi-minute residence in a compact, commercially available packed-bed format.
reasoning_per_field.gas_flow_sccm: 15 sccm inlet flow corresponds to ~6.3 molar equivalents of H2 relative to substrate, providing safety margin above the 1:1 stoichiometric requirement for hydrogenolysis given short flow contact time.
reasoning_per_field.gas_flow_actual_mL_min: In-channel gas flow calculated from STP flow using ideal gas correction for 15 bar/60 °C (correction factor ~0.081).
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_inlet_min: Reference residence time if only liquid flow (0.4 mL/min) is considered, useful for comparing dosing/metering behavior independent of gas expansion.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_in_channel_min: True packed-bed contact time accounting for combined gas+liquid throughput at reactor operating pressure.

literature_analogies: ThalesNano H-Cube continuous-flow hydrogenation of N-benzyl/N-benzhydryl heterocycles using Pd/C or Pd(OH)2 CatCart cartridges, typically 1 mL/min, 40-80 °C, 10-50 bar H2, full conversion in <10 min residence time (multiple H-Cube application notes, e.g., Org. Process Res. Dev. debenzylation studies).

Continuous-flow debenzylation of N-Cbz/N-benzhydryl azetidines and pyrrolidines reported in flow chemistry reviews (e.g., Kobayashi group flow hydrogenation with packed Pd columns), demonstrating improved yield and reduced reaction time vs. batch autoclave hydrogenation.
safety_flags: H2 is flammable/explosive; use ATEX-rated pumps, MFCs, and electrical equipment in the flow skid
Install real-time H2 leak detection sensor near reactor and fittings
Use N2 purge for system startup/shutdown to avoid air/H2 mixtures
Pressure relief valve required downstream of BPR to prevent overpressurization
Vent excess H2 through a catalytic recombiner or well-ventilated fume exhaust, not directly to lab atmosphere
Avoid catalyst bed dry-out/channeling which can cause localized H2 gas pockets and hot spots
AcOH is corrosive; ensure PTFE/stainless wetted parts throughout
